description: This file contains utility functions and encoder mappings for serializing various Python objects, including Pydantic models, dataclasses, enums, and standard library types, into JSON-compatible formats within the FastAPI framework.

methods.name: isoformat
methods.description: Converts a date or time object to its ISO 8601 string representation.

methods.name: decimal_encoder
methods.description: Encodes a Decimal as an int if no exponent, otherwise as a float, to preserve numeric integrity.

methods.name: generate_encoders_by_class_tuples
methods.description: Creates a mapping from encoder functions to the tuple of types they handle.

methods.name: jsonable_encoder
methods.description: Recursively converts Python objects into JSON-serializable formats, supporting Pydantic models, dataclasses, enums, standard types, and custom encoders.
